instruction.thesis: GOLD short was entered at 4,661 on FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG signal (funding was 67.5% annualized). Gold spot has declined to 4,545 (+2.5% P&L, at target). More critically, gold_hl_funding_ann has collapsed from 67.5% to 5.48% — a 91.9% normalization. The core thesis (crowded longs being unwound due to extreme funding) has fully played out: funding is now near baseline, the crowding signal is gone, and holding further exposes us to reversal risk without the carry advantage. The position has reached its 5% target and the signal is exhausted.

instruction.thesis: BTC long was entered at 79,093 on PROMOTED_HYPOTHESIS (H-145/H-148 put-call exhaustion reversal). BTC spot has declined to 78,771 (-0.41%), moving against the thesis. The reversal has not materialized: BTC has drifted lower across 14 snapshots with no bounce, HL funding has turned increasingly negative (-6.6% annualized), suggesting shorts are accumulating rather than covering. The P/C ratio at 0.713 has not shown the normalization/spike that would confirm exhaustion completion. With the stop at 1.5% (~77,700) and no confirming evidence of reversal, the thesis is not playing out within the expected timeframe. Closing to preserve capital rather than waiting for the mechanical stop.
